statement: The v0 rubric (five properties, Stages 0-2) has recorded assessments of two shapes of project: applied-butterfly-mult, a benchmark project, assessed as a nomination and again after setup (Stage 1, 2026-10-17; the nomination's projected grades held, with Orientation one grade higher); and the hub itself. Adapters were tested on six third-party repositories, each probed with and without its adapter. Assessment records have a schema, and a weekly hub check flags stale listings. integer-mult-bounds was graded Stage 1 in an informal smoke test on 2026-10-16 with no record; that grade doesn't count until a recorded assessment replaces it.
status: Rubric applied with records to two projects; record format and scheduled checks in place; thresholds uncalibrated; no donor-tier probe model yet.
scope: Two listed projects with records, of two shapes (benchmark; the hub's own review-only project), plus six unlisted third-party repositories probed for adapter testing. Not yet tested on a replication or conjecture-style listing, or with a donor-tier probe model.

assumptions.statement: Probe answers on the same commit agree. Five assessments of applied-butterfly-mult at 3d2fc58 gave identical grades on every property (issue #4); one repo and one probe model so far.
The thresholds in spec §3.2 are sensible (uncalibrated).
A routine reassessment costs about two short donor sessions. Measured once: an assess session took 5-10 minutes of agent time, plus about 3 minutes per probe.
